Acquisition/hardware

  • Celestron 130EQ 5” Newtonian reflector (130/650)
  • Nikon D3200 DSLR
  • 2x Barlow

Processing/software

  • Moon too large for single frames, cut into 3 portions
  • 1/125” exposure, ISO 200
  • 30 minutes total .mov video manually tracked
  • Stabilized with PIPP, rejected frames without AOI and worst 25%
  • .AVI output from PIPP, stacked with Autostakkert2
  • .TIF output from Autostakkert, wavelets done with Registax
  • .JPEG output from Registax

Bottom Portion

  • 14 minutes total raw (~20,000 frames)
  • Stacked 576 frames

Middle portion

  • 10 minutes total raw (~14,500 frames)
  • Stacked 1,320 frames

Top Portion

  • 6 minutes total raw (~8,500 frames)
  • Stacked 3,480 frames
